title: Booker
description: Representation of the legal contracting party making the reservation.

honorific_prefix.description: Honorific prefix used to address the booker on the reservation and in correspondence. Well-known values: `mr`, `mrs`, `ms`, `mx`, `dr`. Platforms MAY send other values; a Business that does not recognize a value SHOULD address the booker by name only rather than reject the booking. Platforms MUST NOT infer this value from other fields.

phone_number.description: E.164 standard. Phone number of the booker.

birthdate.description: Date of birth of the booker in ISO 8601 format.

nationality.description: Nationality (citizenship) of the booker as an ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code.

company.description: The booker's company or organization name, used for corporate invoicing.

address.description: Physical or registered address of the booker or company for legal contracting, regulatory compliance, and invoicing.
